title: Donald Trump’s climate cuts left thousands jobless; Climate Reserve created a lifeline for 50 experts
summary_full: Donald Trump’s second-term climate cuts scrapped billions in research funding and left thousands of federal workers jobless. In response, climate experts launched Climate Reserve, a multimillion-dollar initiative helping displaced scientists find new roles and revive disrupted projects. The group expected to place 50 experts in new positions while preserving critical climate research and expertise.
